zh.title: 18 次开场，32 路接力
zh.subtitle: 合成样例中，18 个主会话带出了 32 个子智能体。

rows.label: 你怎么做
rows.body: 把问题交给主智能体，再让任务继续往下拆。

rows.label: AI 怎么做
rows.body: 研究、实现和检查，被分给不同角色接力完成。

rows.label: 你的风格
rows.body: 你更像在指挥一支临时乐团，而不是独自敲代码。

zh.tip: 给每个子智能体写清角色、交付格式和验收动作。
zh.image_alt: 一位指挥者面对由多个 AI 机器人组成的像素乐团

en.title: 18 starts, 32 agents in relay
en.subtitle: In this synthetic demo, 18 main sessions led to 32 subagent runs.

rows.label: You did
rows.body: Gave the problem to a lead agent, then let the work branch.

rows.label: Agent did
rows.body: Split research, implementation, and checks across roles.

rows.label: Your style
rows.body: You conduct a temporary ensemble instead of coding alone.

en.tip: Give each agent a role, output format, and acceptance check.
en.image_alt: A pixel conductor facing an orchestra of AI agents

zh.title: 126 分钟，一路做到底
zh.subtitle: 合成样例中，最长活跃段从 21:10 开始，持续了 126 分钟。

rows.label: 你怎么做
rows.body: 21:10 开始，把一条工作线连续推进到底。

rows.label: AI 怎么做
rows.body: 持续读取、修改和执行，陪你把上下文做深。

rows.label: 你的风格
rows.body: 一旦进入状态，你更愿意把一件事连续做透。

zh.tip: 长任务每推进一段就跑测试或截图，让验证跟着进度走。
zh.image_alt: 夜晚，一位使用者和机器人沿发光路线持续工作

en.title: 126 minutes, one continuous run
en.subtitle: In this synthetic demo, the longest run began at 9:10 PM.

rows.label: You did
rows.body: Started at 9:10 PM and kept one workstream moving.

rows.label: Agent did
rows.body: Kept reading, editing, and running in the same context.

rows.label: Your style
rows.body: Once you find the thread, you follow it all the way through.

en.tip: Run a test or capture a screenshot at each milestone.
en.image_alt: A person and an AI robot following a glowing route at night

zh.title: 55% 消息不到 50 字
zh.subtitle: 合成样例的 214 条消息里，有 118 条不到 50 字。

rows.label: 你怎么做
rows.body: 先给一句方向，再看 AI 怎样展开。

rows.label: AI 怎么做
rows.body: 短输入也会启动读取、拆解、修改和验证。

rows.label: 你的风格
rows.body: 你控制方向和节奏，把展开空间留给 AI。

zh.tip: 短句不用变长，只补一个文件、完成标准或验证动作。
zh.image_alt: 一个短指令进入像素机器后被扩展成多道工作流程

en.title: 55% under 50 characters
en.subtitle: In this synthetic demo, 118 of 214 messages were under 50 characters.

rows.label: You did
rows.body: Gave one clear direction, then watched the agent expand it.

rows.label: Agent did
rows.body: Turned short input into reading, editing, and verification.

rows.label: Your style
rows.body: You set direction and tempo, leaving room for expansion.

en.tip: Keep it short; add one file, finish line, or verification step.
en.image_alt: A short prompt expanding into several workflows inside a pixel machine

zh.title: 14 次「继续」，保持惯性
zh.subtitle: 合成样例中，continue / 继续在 14 条消息里出现。

rows.label: 你怎么做
rows.body: 方向没变时，用一句“继续”维持工作的惯性。

rows.label: AI 怎么做
rows.body: 沿着已有上下文继续读取、修改和检查。

rows.label: 你的风格
rows.body: 你喜欢在同一条线上校准，而不是反复重写需求。

zh.tip: 继续前让 AI 用一行报：已完成、未验证、下一步。
zh.image_alt: 一位使用者鼓励机器人沿着像素台阶继续前进

en.title: 14 “continues”, momentum intact
en.subtitle: In this synthetic demo, continue / 继续 appeared in 14 messages.

rows.label: You did
rows.body: Used one word to preserve momentum when the direction held.

rows.label: Agent did
rows.body: Continued reading, editing, and checking the same context.

rows.label: Your style
rows.body: You calibrate one workstream instead of rewriting the brief.

en.tip: Before continuing, ask for one line: done, unverified, next.
en.image_alt: A person encouraging a robot up a sequence of pixel steps
